title: The Updates index is the Chatticus progress desk
description:
**As a** visitor, **I want** /updates to state that it is Chatticus progress notes, **so that** I know this desk is about the product itself.

The page is the desk: masthead plus an empty article list. No coming-soon hedging.

Feature: Marketing blog

  Scenario: Updates index states it is Chatticus progress notes
    Given a visitor on the Updates page
    Then the page states that Updates is progress notes about Chatticus itself
    And the page lists no articles yet
    And the page does not say coming soon
